skills.name: gilguard
skills.description: Catch the import that re-enables the GIL on free-threaded Python (3.13t, 3.14t, 3.15t). Use when adding gilguard to an app, test suite or CI, when a GILEnabledError or GILGuardWarning shows up, when choosing between raise, warn and off, or when auditing an environment with python -m gilguard.
